attributes.action: Freeze and Lower Wandsworth Council Tax to Support Local Residents
attributes.additional_details: Urgent Cost-of-Living Relief: Local families, pensioners, and young professionals across Wandsworth are facing unprecedented pressures from skyrocketing rent, energy bills, and everyday food costs.
attributes.background: “We, the undersigned residents of the London Borough of Wandsworth, call on Wandsworth Council to implement an immediate freeze and a structured reduction on Council Tax rates for the upcoming financial year to alleviate the severe financial pressure on local households.”

rejection.details:
We can't accept petitions that call for action at a local level.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

You could also raise your concerns directly with Wandsworth Council, which is responsible for setting council tax rates in the borough.

Wandsworth Council has its own petitions system, which you can find here: https://www.wandsworth.gov.uk/the-council/have-your-say/petitions/
